company.name: Okera
company.shortDescription: Okera is a data authorization company.
company.description: Okera provides secure data access at scale so that data teams have the confidence to unlock the power of their data for innovation and growth. By ensuring that appropriate data access controls are in place and meet the evolving data privacy landscape, the Okera Active Data Access Platform can automatically discover and audit data lakes, create access policies using its no-code visual policy engine, and enforce fine-grained access in hybrid and multi-cloud environments such as AWS and Azure. Okera is headquartered in San Francisco and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, ClearSky Security, and Felicis Ventures.

aiResearchSummary.text: Okera is researching enhancements for operating data access application services, as described in Data Retrieval Using Distributed Workers in a Large-Scale Data Access System, which details methods for handling client requests in distributed environments. Additionally, Systems and methods for a virtual sandbox database focuses on management of big data storage and data access control systems, including sandbox databases for users. These areas reflect Okera’s focus on secure and scalable data authorization solutions.
